text:
Priya (CS): quick thread — creating a compact, customer-facing mini-playbook for go-live and renewal signal capture. need crisp items we can hand to customers + an internal escalation map.

Abe (SE): keep it tiny. core bullets:
- preflight: run top-5 user flows, record med + p95 latency
- prefill: enable for bursty traffic, TTL 600-1800s depending on session length
- batching: start with initial_batch_size=4, max_batch_size=12, jitter_ms=30
- streaming: enable partial retries=1 and capture partial_stream_errors

Nora (CS): feedback cadence: day0 (first 24h), day3, day14. Survey: latency ok? errors encountered? paste 3 critical prompts. Attach responses to account notes.

Vik (Product): add renewal-risk rules for automation (CS alert + SE pairing):
- cache_hit_rate down > 40% vs baseline over 24h
- p95_latency > SLA + 300ms for 2 consecutive hours
- partial_stream_errors > 3x baseline in 6h
Also flag if customer asks to disable caching for >1d (potential UX regression).

Abe (SE): copyable YAML for customers to paste into onboarding repo:
```
prefill: true
prefill_ttl_seconds: 900
batching:
  initial_batch_size: 4
  max_batch_size: 12
  jitter_ms: 30
streaming:
  enable_streaming: true
  partial_retry_limit: 1
```

Priya (CS): customer-facing one-liner to include: "Enable prefill for bursty traffic and keep TTL short to warm capacity without high idle cost." short + actionable.

Nora (CS): escalation matrix (internal):
- incident (p95 latency up, errors spike): page oncall + SE lead immediately
- cache regressions: CS -> SE within 2 hours, run paired smoke test
- streaming regressions: CS triage -> route to non-streaming fallback and notify product

Abe (SE): debug tips for on-call / SE pairing:
- run with jitter_ms=0 for a controlled test to observe raw concurrency
- enable tracing for 5-10 mins only (privacy/timebox)
- compare cache hit histogram by user segment (session vs ad-hoc)

OpsBot: note: template saved as "CS Mini Playbook — Warmup, Batching, Streaming" by Priya.

Priya (CS): action items:
- i'll author a 1-page PDF + a 2-slide talking doc (ETA: tomorrow noon)
- Abe: add YAML snippet to onboarding repo + provide copy link (ETA: 24h)
- Nora: i'll run two dry-run smoke tests with high-touch accounts this week

Vik (Product): add short fallback guidance to doc: "If model variant fails, failover to smaller compatible variant and notify CS to avoid user-visible outage."

Priya (CS): perfect — i'll post draft here for quick review once done. :thumbsup:
